description:
KCB's remaining counts and KMI's Steps 8–10 — the two specs the ladder ranks last, taken together because KMI's second count IS KCB's re-run.

KCB, per docs/reference/promotability.md: 'the most work, and the most implemented.' FIVE independent counts as of 0.5.0 with NO fold outstanding — V-1…V-7 landed at 0.5.0, MA-6/MA-8/MA-9 at 0.4.9. What remains is four re-runs of folded text plus a re-run outstanding since 2026-07-22: `e2e-media-transform.md` (the 0.3.0 AgentCard-extension shape), `e2e-live-schema-mutation.md` (V-2/V-4/V-5/V-7 blocking, now against the 0.5.0 fold), `kcb-subscription-firehose.md` (§4.2 backpressure, KCB 0.4.7) and `kcb-cross-owner-posture.md` (§4.3 autonomy posture, KCB 0.4.8). `89` clears the fifth (Steps 5–7 of the multi-authority walk), which is why this depends on it.

READING GREEN IS THE NAMED HAZARD HERE. 'KCB is the spec where reading `green` as a verdict does the most damage: `kcs:live-schema-mutation` and `kcs:multi-authority` both came back green over passes with four and six blocking deltas open (DR-7, DR-8).' Walk the prose.

WHAT WILL STILL BLOCK KCB AFTER FOUR CLEAN RE-RUNS. CORRECTED 2026-09-02: koine's record says §4.2 and §4.3 'lack a KCS encoding entirely' (DR-12, DR-13). Both are FALSE. agora `378fd3c` encoded all three outstanding pressure tests on 2026-08-26 12:30 — 49 minutes after koine's gate doc was last written — and `subscription-firehose.ts` and `cross-owner-posture.ts` are registered in `console/src/kcs/scenarios/index.ts` with `coverage.test.ts` asserting 12 scenarios and passing. What genuinely remains: count (ii)'s encoding must be EXTENDED past the fold it predates (DR-7); §4.3 carries ADR-0013's retained second-independent-implementation condition (W3); and ADR-0014 — the single finding of the fold cross-read — lands with counts (ii) and (iii), moving neither and closing neither. The reference implementation read against the folded text shows the standalone manifest 0.5.0 removed is still its only crawl path (AG-1) and its manifest type carries neither `version` nor `schema_id` (AG-2), so §7 is unexercised outside this tree.

KMI: 'the fold landed; now a re-run, then a wait.' MA-5's two optional §2 fields and MA-10's answerable absence went in additively at 0.3.5. What is left on count (i) is a re-run of Steps 8–10; after that KMI is blocked on KCB's re-run, which is not KMI's work.

userStories.title: The four KCB re-runs, walked against folded text, one verdict each
userStories.notes: Four hand-walks, one verdict each, none closes. All five koine guards green (doc-integrity OK / doc-links 0 dead vs 0 on main / tasklist-categories OK / schemas OK 9 schemas 3 fixtures / registry OK 29 relations); .chief/verify.sh over the changed set: verify-test 30 passed, 0 failed, 'all selected gates green'. Verdicts: (i) e2e-media-transform NOT clean -> MT-1; (ii) e2e-live-schema-mutation NOT clean -> V-9/V-10/V-11 + ADR-0014 reproduces with a single registry + Step 6 mis-filing corrected; (iv) kcb-subscription-firehose NOT clean -> BP-7/BP-8 (BP-5 does not reproduce); (v) kcb-cross-owner-posture NOT clean -> AP-9 (8 of 8 AP deltas flip). V-2/V-4/V-5/V-7 individually re-checked against the 0.5.0 fold: all four flip. No version and no clause moved in any spec.
acceptanceCriteria: `e2e-media-transform.md`, `e2e-live-schema-mutation.md`, `kcb-subscription-firehose.md` and `kcb-cross-owner-posture.md` are each re-run against the current folded text, each with its own recorded verdict against the section it gates. Five counts 'each gating only its own section' — a combined verdict destroys that structure.
The walks are against the PROSE. DR-7 and DR-8 record two of these very encodings returning green over passes with four and six blocking deltas open, so an encoding's exit code is not the verdict.
`e2e-live-schema-mutation.md`'s V-2/V-4/V-5/V-7 are individually re-checked against the 0.5.0 fold that landed 2026-08-26, since that fold is what the re-run exists to test.

userStories.title: KMI's Steps 8–10, and its wait recorded honestly
userStories.notes: Steps 8-10 re-attacked by hand against KMI 0.3.5 / KCB 0.5.0 after US-1's four KCB walks; count (i) verdict: NOT clean. Step 8 holds, Step 10 re-confirms MA-12 (and constrains its fold), Step 9 REVERSES the chief/89 pass -> new delta MA-13 (High, structural): two conformant envelopes for one asset id may carry different license/egress pairs, S7.1(e) bullet 2 is a MUST over 'an asset's egress' while every operand a holder can obtain is a property of an envelope, and nothing ranks them. Count (i) now needs two additive folds (MA-12 two-spec, MA-13 KMI-only), both unowned. All three status conditions recorded and NONE holds: (i) open; (ii) e2e-media-transform re-run walked same day, NOT clean -> MT-1, and KCB's work; (iii) conformance gate fails on two documents (DR-4; DR-8/DR-7). KMI stays Candidate; no version and no clause moved. GATES: all five koine guards green (doc-integrity OK, 59 files / 1599 links, 3 status tables match; doc-links 0 dead vs 0 on main; tasklist-categories OK; schemas OK 9 schemas / 3 fixtures; registry OK 29 relations). .chief/verify.sh over the changed set: verify-test 30 passed, 0 failed, 'all selected gates green'.
acceptanceCriteria: Steps 8–10 are re-run and count (i) gets a verdict. This is KMI's own work and is independent of KCB.

KMI's status moves ONLY if count (i) is clean AND KCB's media-transform re-run is clean — the ladder says the prose half 'is blocked only because the same scenario also gates KCB's manifest change', and additionally needs `kcs:media-transform` (F4). Record all three conditions and which hold.

userStories.title: What remains after clean re-runs is written down, not left to be rediscovered
userStories.notes: Register of what remains after the four KCB walks, written flat with owners. DR-7 (count (ii)'s encoding must be EXTENDED to the F1-F13 set, downstream), W3 (ADR-0013's second-independent-implementation condition on §4.3, external) and ADR-0014's four-part clause (a precondition of counts (ii) AND (iii), not one) each recorded as explicitly UNOWNED, alongside the four new folds (MT-1; V-9+V-11; V-10+BP-8+AP-9 as ONE edit; BP-7) - seven items, all unowned. DR-12/DR-13 recorded CLOSED and VERIFIED BY RUNNING at agora c971fc2 (working tree clean), not taken on the description's word: coverage.test.ts 3 passed / 0 failed (53 assertions), evidence.test.ts 13 passed / 0 failed (98 assertions), artifact current at sha256-eb8fdc9c...36dd5, 12 scenarios, kcs:subscription-firehose gates 'KCB §4.2' and kcs:cross-owner-posture gates 'KCB §4.3 (ADR-0013)', both green/partial-live. AG-1 and AG-2 RE-READ at that same sha and both STAND: registry/src/crawl.ts still builds only KCB_MANIFEST_PATH, and Capability has no `version` while KnowledgePort/MediaPort/EntityPort carry no `schema_id`. Two AG findings moved and are corrected on the record: AG-3 two-thirds closed (IssuedGrant now carries issuer + budget_unit), AG-5 CLOSED (SPEC_VERSIONS.kcb 0.4.6 -> 0.4.9 with the 0.5.0 lag declared - a pre-1.0 minor is breaking under that build's own compatibility rule). KCB is NOT promoted and would not have been on five clean re-runs; the blockers are named. 'Cheapest first' re-derived across all 11 verdicts of 2026-09-03: order 2-6 holds (proof and next-move triggers stated per row), and rows 5/6 are now COUPLED - KMI's remainder strictly contains KCB count (i). GATES: all five koine guards green (doc-integrity OK, 3 status tables match; doc-links 0 dead vs 0 on main; tasklist-categories OK; schemas OK; registry OK). git diff --name-only main | .chief/verify.sh --run -> verify-test 30 passed, 0 failed, 'all selected gates green'.
acceptanceCriteria: DR-7 (count (ii)'s encoding must be extended past the fold it predates), W3 (ADR-0013's second-independent-implementation condition on §4.3) and ADR-0014's queued clause change are each recorded with an owner named or explicitly unowned. DR-12 and DR-13 are recorded as CLOSED — agora encoded them on 2026-08-26 and koine's record never caught up; verify that against agora at a named sha rather than taking this description's word for it.

AG-1 and AG-2 are recorded against the reference implementation: the standalone manifest 0.5.0 removed is still its only crawl path, and its manifest type carries neither `version` nor `schema_id`, so §7 is unexercised outside this tree. These are downstream facts, stated here, not fixed here.

KCB is NOT promoted by this tasklist even on four clean re-runs, and the record says which of the remaining conditions blocks it. The ladder's whole purpose is that a reader should not have to run the audit six times.
`promotability.md`'s 'Cheapest first' ranking is re-ordered to match what these walks changed.
